metadata.Name: Defensin-like protein (Flower-specific gamma-thionin; Plant defensin)
metadata.Comments:
Function: Involved in floral organogenesis. May play a protective role in flowers by protecting the reproductive organs from potential pathogen attack.
Tissue specificity: Found in petals, stamen and pistils, but not in sepals. In particular, accumulation in a configuration surrounding the inner reproductive whorls.
